name: Self test
description: A Lua test tool: on entering the world it calls every function the test mods give the client's Lua and checks each answer, sends chat and addon messages, makes mods reload, break and repair a manifest, provokes casts and an item use, reloads the interface and logs back in, reads served files, hangs and places models, checks the asset bricks, the camera and bone watchers; every result is a PASS, FAIL, SKIP or NOTE line in the log.
